mapper.select: SELECT /* getWelcomePageList */ W.WLCM_NUMB, W.VERS_NUMB, W.SUBX_TITL, W.MAIN_TITL, W.PAGE_DESC, W.IMGE_URLX , W.SORT_ORDR, W.DPLY_YSNO , W.REGI_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(W.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME, W.REGI_DATE , W.UPDT_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(W.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME, W.UPDT_DATE , W.DPLY_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(W.DPLY_ADMN) AS DPLY_ADMN_NAME, W.DPLY_DATE FROM CT_WLCMPG W INNER JOIN ( SELECT WLCM_NUMB , COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN DPLY_YSNO = #{yes} THEN VERS_NUMB END) , MAX(VERS_NUMB)) AS VERS_NUMB FROM CT_WLCMPG GROUP BY WLCM_NUMB ) L ON L.WLCM_NUMB = W.WLCM_NUMB AND L.VERS_NUMB = W.VERS_NUMB ORDER BY W.SORT_ORDR, W.WLCM_NUMB

SELECT /* getWelcomePageDtl */ W.WLCM_NUMB, W.VERS_NUMB, W.SUBX_TITL, W.MAIN_TITL, W.PAGE_DESC, W.IMGE_URLX , W.SORT_ORDR, W.DPLY_YSNO , W.REGI_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(W.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME, W.REGI_DATE , W.UPDT_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(W.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME, W.UPDT_DATE , W.DPLY_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(W.DPLY_ADMN) AS DPLY_ADMN_NAME, W.DPLY_DATE FROM CT_WLCMPG W WHERE W.WLCM_NUMB = #{wlcmNumb} AND W.VERS_NUMB = #{versNumb}

SELECT /* getWelcomePageVersionList */ WLCM_NUMB, VERS_NUMB, SUBX_TITL, MAIN_TITL, PAGE_DESC, IMGE_URLX, SORT_ORDR, DPLY_YSNO , REGI_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME, REGI_DATE , UPDT_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME, UPDT_DATE , DPLY_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(DPLY_ADMN) AS DPLY_ADMN_NAME, DPLY_DATE FROM CT_WLCMPG WHERE WLCM_NUMB = #{wlcmNumb} ORDER BY VERS_NUMB DESC
SELECT /* getWelcomeOriginalAudit */ REGI_ADMN, REGI_DATE FROM CT_WLCMPG WHERE WLCM_NUMB = #{wlcmNumb} AND VERS_NUMB = 1
SELECT /* getLatestVersionForUpdate */ VERS_NUMB FROM CT_WLCMPG WHERE WLCM_NUMB = #{wlcmNumb} ORDER BY VERS_NUMB DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptWelcomePageDeployOff */ CT_WLCMPG SET DPLY_YSNO = #{no} WHERE WLCM_NUMB = #{wlcmNumb} AND DPLY_YSNO = #{yes}
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delWelcomePage */ FROM CT_WLCMPG WHERE WLCM_NUMB = #{wlcmNumb}
